content.title: Hulu + Live TV: Don't Sign Up Until You Know This...
content.text: Hulu + Live TV is a live TV streaming service that comes bundled together with standard Hulu, Disney+, and ESPN+ (aka the Disney Bundle). It has a similar channel lineup to other live TV services like YouTube TV, but with some exceptions. In this video, I break down everything you need to know before you sign up for Hulu + Live TV including their plans and pricing, channel lineup, on-demand movies and shows, the difference between Hulu vs Hulu + Live TV, and more. ✅Deal alert!
